scope:

Reports raw window measurements and health checks. A sequential pair cannot
attribute a change to one optimization or establish repeat-run variance.

observed_menu_frame_counters.acceptance_basis: Actual initialized lineup must match; the observed pre-ENTER counter can differ because input is applied by a later frame.

limitations: Sequential physical runs with matching driver, roster and window order; no per-feature causal attribution.
The actual Game continues to advance between windows; corresponding live snapshots need not be byte-identical.
Resource/audio/cache sample RPCs are outside the FPS counter interval; their counter deltas cover slightly wider time.
Physical resource counters include independent RAW audio reads. They are not exclusively visual IO.
No repeated-run confidence interval or guaranteed FPS bound is inferred.
Missing required observations remain null or fail their schema check; they are never treated as zero.
